result.question: Qual a média de dias de internação por município?
result.gold_sql: SELECT mu.nome AS municipio, AVG(i."DIAS_PERM") AS media_dias_internacao FROM internacoes i JOIN municipios mu ON i."MUNIC_RES" = mu.codigo_6d GROUP BY mu.nome ORDER BY media_dias_internacao DESC;
result.generated_sql: SELECT mu.nome AS municipio, AVG(i."DIAS_PERM") AS media_dias_permanencia FROM internacoes i JOIN municipios mu ON i."MUNIC_RES" = mu."codigo_6d" GROUP BY mu.nome ORDER BY media_dias_permanencia DESC;
